idea-plugin.name: Blackboard
idea-plugin.description:
A quick, project-specific Markdown scratchpad that lives right inside Rider. Press Alt+B, jot down a thought, press Alt+B again and you are back in your code.

Keep TODOs, debugging notes, snippets, links and half-formed ideas next to the solution they belong to, without leaving the IDE or switching to a separate notes app.

Features

  • One note per project — each solution has its own Blackboard, stored as a plain blackboard.md file in the project's .idea folder.
  • Instant toggle — Alt+B opens the note with the caret ready for typing, and hides it again, returning focus to the editor you came from.
  • Automatic saving — no Save button: changes are written after a second of idle time, at least every few seconds while you type, and when the project closes.
  • Safe writes — atomic file writes, a save status line, a Retry button and a notification if saving fails, and a warning when the file is changed outside the IDE. Your text is never silently lost.
  • Markdown editor — syntax highlighting via the bundled Markdown plugin (falls back to plain text if it is disabled).
  • Native look — uses your IDE theme and editor font, no custom colors.

Getting started

Press Alt+B, click the Blackboard button on the right tool window bar, or use View | Tool Windows | Blackboard. The shortcut can be changed in Settings | Keymap (search for Toggle Blackboard).
